changes.before: Medium shot a London resident tipping a household bundle into the Thames, soft daylight. A seventeenth-century British setting: people have adult faces and linen cuffs, knee-length trousers or long coats; no Asian court costume or modern fixtures
changes.after: Medium shot at the Thames bank in 1666: one grey-haired adult London resident in a dark wool doublet and white linen collar leans forward and releases a tied linen household bundle with both hands over the stone river edge; the bundle is airborne above the open water, with small ripples below and pale overcast sky behind
